<tspan x="943.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="943.0" y="1748" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="943.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: ccbn with norm_style=bn, mybn=False, cross_replica=False, which_linear=nn.Linear selected.
source_contracts: F.batch_norm(x, self.stored_mean, self.stored_var, None, None, self.training, 0.1, self.eps)

sourceFacts: Two independent condition heads predict per-example gain and bias; gain has an explicit +1 offset.
Feature normalization has no affine parameters. stored_mean/var are buffers and the selected training call may update them inside the library.
F.batch_norm receives literal momentum .1, irrespective of the constructor self.momentum attribute.
Other branches are excluded. The GN path references self.normstyle, a source typo, and is not silently repaired.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
